children: Bitcoin fell to two-year lows near $55,000 this week amid $2.4 billion in liquidations and extreme fear. Most altcoins quickly followed it lower.
However, three tokens posted clear gains and held up far better than the broader market.
1. Pieverse (PIEVERSE)
Pieverse is a BNB Chain project that builds infrastructure for AI agents. The token trades near $3.01,
over the past week.
The rally followed the early-access launch of Confidential Agents. The feature uses hardware-backed privacy to protect agent memory, messages, and credentials.
Moreover, the market absorbed a large mid-November unlock without major selling.
Bullish: A sustained move above $3.10 to $3.14 could open the path toward $3.50 to $3.60.
Bearish: A break below $2.50 to $2.60 could send PIEVERSE toward $2.00.
2. Venice Token (VVV)
Venice Token trades near $22.72, up about 11% in 24 hours and 25% over the past week. The project launched Venice Minds, an AI assistant marketplace that funds VVV burns.
Meanwhile, Arthur Hayes named VVV
, with a $40 target.
“The size is small to medium as conviction is meh, but if the music playing you gotta dance,” he wrote.
Days later, on-chain data showed a wallet linked to him receiving 15,000 VVV. As a result, VVV’s market cap now tops $1.1 billion.
Bullish: Reclaiming $25 could open a move toward Hayes’ $40 target.
Bearish: A daily close below $19 to $20 could push VVV toward $16 to $17.
3. Pearl (PEARL)
Pearl is a Bitcoin-derived layer-1 blockchain that uses Proof of Useful Work. Its miners perform matrix multiplications, the core GPU operation behind AI training, instead of traditional hashing.

PEARL trades near $1.75, up roughly 13.4% over the past week despite a 7.1% dip in the last 24 hours. On November 17, the project advanced its FP8 upgrade on testnet, which aims to align mining with existing AI formats.
Recent Coinbase and Kraken listings also boosted demand.
Bullish: Reclaiming $2.00 to $2.20 could open a move toward the previous high near $2.46.
Bearish: A break below $1.50 could reopen downside toward $1.20 to $1.30.
For now, all three remain resilient. However, their next moves will depend on whether Bitcoin stabilizes. Their own catalysts will also need to keep attracting buyers.

title: 3 Altcoins Defy the Market Crash as Bitcoin Hits a Two-Year Low
